items.source: Delegates to createMockMvc(Filter[], MockServletConfig, WebApplicationContext, RequestBuilder, List, List, List) for creation of the MockMvc instance and configures that instance with the supplied defaultResponseCharacterEncoding.
items.translation: 委托给createMockMvc(Filter[], MockServletConfig, WebApplicationContext, RequestBuilder, List, List, List)以创建MockMvc实例，并使用提供的defaultResponseCharacterEncoding配置该实例。

items.source: DefaultMockMvcBuilder, which derives from this class, provides a concrete build method, and delegates to abstract methods to obtain a WebApplicationContext.
items.translation: DefaultMockMvcBuilder，该类继承自此类，提供了一个具体的 build 方法，并委托抽象方法来获取一个 WebApplicationContext。

items.source: Rossen Stoyanchev, Rob Winch, Stephane Nicoll, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Rossen Stoyanchev, Rob Winch, Stephane Nicoll, Sam Brannen
